Name: NPC Map Locations-Chinese(for v3.5.2-2026.4.26)
Author: ShadowSirius
Description:
[heading]描述/Description[/heading]
本汉化包为 [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/239?tab=description]NPC Map Locations[/url][/b] 自制简体中文翻译，完整汉化界面、菜单、提示文本，不修改原版功能，适配官方安装与运行规范，让中文玩家顺畅使用 NPC 地图定位功能。
Fan-made Simplified Chinese translation for [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/239?tab=description]NPC Map Locations[/url][/b]. Fully translates UI, menus and tooltips without altering original functionality, following official installation & runtime specs for smooth use by Chinese players.
